mapper.insert: insert into basket_discipline_suspension_log (discipline_id, match_id, member_id, consume_count, idempotency_key, create_time, update_time, is_delete) values (#{disciplineId}, #{matchId}, #{memberId}, #{consumeCount}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{isDelete})
mapper.select: select count(*) from basket_discipline_suspension_log where idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey} and is_delete = 0
